name: Quick Pill 5.5.6
changelog: Fix: The auto-updater now really installs the update. The installer helper was started as a child of Quick Pill, so Windows killed it together with the app - it is now started through the Windows shell and survives the restart.
Fix: The installer helper waits for Quick Pill to fully exit, releases the audio helper lock, installs silently and starts the new version again.
Fix: The update detection is written to quick-pill.log so a pending update is visible even when the automatic download is disabled.
Note: Updates released before v5.5.6 have to be installed once manually (run the downloaded Setup.exe), after that the in-app updater works again.
